heroHeadline: Death Toll Crosses 3,000; 45-Day Ceasefire Extended as IDF Brigade Commander Wounded by Hezbollah Fiber-Optic Drone
heroSubtitle: Lebanese Health Ministry confirmed 3,073+ killed since March 2 as Israel extended the ceasefire 45 days to June 30; Hezbollah's unjammable fiber-optic FPV drones wounded an IDF armoured brigade commander on May 20; 1.2 million remain displaced; post-UNIFIL transition talks opened in Beirut
footerNote: Data sourced from UN UNIFIL, World Bank, IMF, Special Tribunal for Lebanon, HRW, Amnesty International, L'Orient Le Jour, Reuters, Al Jazeera, Lebanese Ministry of Public Health, UN Security Council Report, IOM, and scholarly consensus from UNESCO, Oxford, and Cambridge. Ancient history based on archaeological and textual evidence with noted uncertainties.
